# Tenuta Odegitria

> Masseria with an 18th-century trulli hamlet in Martina Franca (TA), Itria Valley (Valle d'Itria), Puglia, Italy. Six accommodations (4 trulli + 2 in the manor house) for 2–4 guests each, 21 beds in total, with a shared 6×14 m outdoor swimming pool, tennis court, free parking with EV charging, Wi‑Fi, pets allowed. Holiday rentals or bed & breakfast, direct booking. Also a wedding venue with legally valid civil ceremonies on site.

Official website of Tenuta Odegitria, run directly by the owners Anna Maria Calella and Giovanni Conserva, who live on the estate. Website languages: Italian (default), English, French.

## Key facts

- Name: Tenuta Odegitria
- Type: masseria (Apulian farmhouse estate) with authentic 18th-century trulli; holiday apartments and B&B; wedding and event venue
- Address: Strada Cupa-Battaglini 32/A, 74015 Martina Franca (TA), Puglia, Italy
- Coordinates: 40.7279158, 17.323033
- Approximate driving distances: Martina Franca old town 2 km, Locorotondo 4 km, Cisternino about 12 km, Alberobello about 13 km, Ostuni about 30 km, Taranto about 35 km, Adriatic Sea (Monopoli) about 35 km, Brindisi Airport about 60 km, Bari Airport about 80 km; 1 km from the SS 172 "dei Trulli" road. A car is recommended.
- Phone / WhatsApp: +39 338 565 5351
- Email: info@tenutaodegitria.it
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tenutaodegitria/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/tenutaodegitria
- Accommodations: 6 (Agrifoglio Room, Trullo dell'Aia, Trullo La Corte, Trullo Il Pagliaio, Trullo Il Palmento Suite, Pino e Lecci Apartment), 2–4 guests each, 21 beds in total
- Shared amenities: outdoor swimming pool 6×14 m, tennis court, garden, barbecue area, free on-site parking, free Wi‑Fi, air conditioning and heating, private outdoor area for each accommodation
- Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 10:00
- Pets allowed (please notify when booking)
- Electric vehicle charging station in the car park
- On request (extra charge): typical buffet breakfast in the breakfast room, shared hot tub; cot and high chair on request
- Booking conditions: 30% deposit to confirm; balance on arrival by credit card, bank transfer or cash; with the refundable rate, free cancellation up to 30 days before arrival (non-refundable offers: 100% charged)
- Weddings: officially recognised civil registry office (art. 3 DPR 396/2000) for legally valid civil ceremonies on site; Italian garden, oak grove, threshing floor, pool, trulli hamlet and a hall with panoramic windows; weddings and events up to about 200 guests; free choice of caterer; exclusive use; trullo bridal suite

## How to check availability and book

Prices and availability change in real time and are not listed here. Use the official booking engine (Kross Booking):

- All accommodations: https://tenutaodegitria.kross.travel/en/rooms?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD&guests_rooms=ADULTS,CHILDREN;
- Example (2 adults, 2027-06-12 to 2027-06-15): https://tenutaodegitria.kross.travel/en/rooms?from=2027-06-12&to=2027-06-15&guests_rooms=2,0;
- Booking section on this website: https://tenutaodegitria.it/en/#prenota-ora

## Accommodation details (English)

### Agrifoglio Room

URL: https://tenutaodegitria.it/en/agrifoglio.html
Booking: https://tenutaodegitria.kross.travel/room-agrifoglio?lang=en

- Type: Room in the masseria (B&B)
- Guests: Up to 4 (2 adults + 2 children/teens)
- Beds: 1 double bed + 1 double sofa bed
- Bathroom: Private, with shower
- Size: 20 m²
- Floor: First floor of the manor house
- Kitchen: No (fridge in the room)
- View: Over the trulli

The Agrifoglio room is on the first floor of the manor house of Tenuta Odegitria, a recently restored historic masseria with trulli in Martina Franca, in the heart of the Itria Valley (Puglia). Two windows overlook the trulli.
It has a double bed and a double sofa bed, ideal for two children or teens, plus a private bathroom, fridge, TV, air conditioning and heating. There is no kitchenette: it is designed for a bed & breakfast stay, with a typical buffet breakfast available on request.
Guests have a private outdoor area and can use the estate’s shared swimming pool (6×14 m) and tennis court.

Ideal for: Couples and families with children who prefer a B&B stay.

FAQ:

Q: How many guests can Agrifoglio Room accommodate?
A: Up to 4 guests (2 adults + 2 children/teens). Beds: 1 double bed + 1 double sofa bed.

Q: What type of accommodation is Agrifoglio Room?
A: A B&B room in the masseria of 20 m² at Tenuta Odegitria, a masseria with an 18th-century trulli hamlet in Martina Franca (TA), in the Itria Valley, Puglia. Ideal for: couples and families with children who prefer a B&B stay.

Q: Does Agrifoglio Room have a kitchen?
A: No, there is no kitchen (there is a fridge). A typical buffet breakfast is available on request for an extra charge.

Q: Is the Agrifoglio room suitable for a family?
A: Yes. Besides the double bed there is a double sofa bed for two children or teens, and a cot for babies aged 0–3 is available on request.

Q: Is breakfast included?
A: A typical buffet breakfast, served in the breakfast room, is available on request for an extra charge, so you can also book room only.

Q: Can guests use the swimming pool and tennis court?
A: Yes, guests have access to the estate’s outdoor swimming pool (6×14 m) and tennis court, shared with other guests. A shared hot tub is also available on request for an extra charge.

Q: Is there parking and Wi‑Fi?
A: Yes: free on-site parking with an electric vehicle charging station, and free Wi‑Fi. A car is recommended to explore the Itria Valley.

Q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
A: Check-in is from 2:00 pm, check-out by 10:00 am.

Q: Are pets allowed?
A: Yes, pets are welcome: please let us know when you book.

Q: Can we stay with a baby?
A: Yes, a cot and high chair are available on request.

Q: How do I book Agrifoglio Room and what are the conditions?
A: Online from this page, with real-time availability and prices, or by contacting us on +39 338 565 5351 (also WhatsApp) or at info@tenutaodegitria.it. A 30% deposit is required to confirm the booking; the balance is paid on arrival by credit card, bank transfer or cash. With the refundable rate, cancellation is free up to 30 days before arrival.

Q: Where is Agrifoglio Room located?
A: At Tenuta Odegitria, Strada Cupa-Battaglini 32/A, 74015 Martina Franca (TA), Puglia, Italy: 2 km from the centre of Martina Franca, 4 km from Locorotondo and 1 km from the SS 172 “dei Trulli” road, in the heart of the Itria Valley.

### Trullo dell’Aia

URL: https://tenutaodegitria.it/en/trullodellaia.html
Booking: https://tenutaodegitria.kross.travel/trullo-dell-aia?lang=en

- Type: Trullo apartment (holiday home)
- Guests: Up to 4 (2 adults + 2 children/teens)
- Rooms: Double bedroom + living room with fireplace
- Beds: 1 double bed + 1 double sofa bed
- Bathroom: Private, with shower
- Size: 40 m²
- Kitchen: Equipped kitchenette with fridge
- Outdoor: Private area with table and chairs

Trullo dell’Aia is a 40 m² trullo apartment in the 18th-century trulli hamlet of Tenuta Odegitria, a masseria in Martina Franca, in the Itria Valley. It has two separate entrances.
It features a double bedroom with its own entrance door, a living room with a traditional stone fireplace and a sofa bed for two children or teens, an equipped kitchenette and a private bathroom. Air-conditioned in summer and heated in winter.
Outside there is a private area with a garden table and chairs; guests can use the estate’s shared swimming pool and tennis court.

Ideal for: Families and small groups looking for space and independence.

### Trullo Il Pagliaio

URL: https://tenutaodegitria.it/en/trulloilpagliaio.html
Booking: https://tenutaodegitria.kross.travel/trullo-il-pagliaio?lang=en

- Type: Trullo apartment (holiday home / B&B)
- Guests: Up to 3 (2 adults + 1 child/teen)
- Rooms: Double bedroom + living room
- Beds: 1 double bed + 1 single sofa bed
- Bathroom: Private, with shower
- Size: 30 m²
- Kitchen: Equipped kitchenette with fridge
- Outdoor: Private area with table and chairs

Trullo Il Pagliaio is a 30 m² trullo apartment converted from an old hayloft of Tenuta Odegitria, a masseria with trulli in Martina Franca, in the heart of the Itria Valley.
It has a living room with a single sofa bed for one child or teen, an equipped kitchenette with fridge, a double bedroom with its own entrance door and a private bathroom. Air-conditioned in summer and heated in winter.
Outside there is a private area with a garden table and chairs; guests can use the estate’s shared swimming pool and tennis court.

Ideal for: Couples or families with one child who want to sleep in an authentic trullo.

FAQ:

Q: How many guests can Trullo Il Pagliaio accommodate?

Q: Does Trullo Il Pagliaio have a kitchen?
A: Yes: equipped kitchenette with fridge.

Q: Why is it called “Il Pagliaio”?
A: Because the trullo was created from the masseria’s old hayloft (pagliaio), where straw and hay were once stored, restored while keeping its original stone structure.

Q: Are pets allowed?
A: Yes, pets are welcome: please let us know when you book.

Q: Can we stay with a baby?
A: Yes, a cot and high chair are available on request.

### Trullo Il Palmento Suite

URL: https://tenutaodegitria.it/en/trulloilpalmento.html
Booking: https://tenutaodegitria.kross.travel/trullo-il-palmento-suite?lang=en

- Type: Trullo suite
- Guests: Up to 2 adults
- Rooms: Entrance, alcove bedroom, relaxation corner
- Beds: 1 double bed
- Bathroom: Private, with shower and stone hot tub
- Size: 30 m²
- Comfort: Air conditioning and underfloor heating
- Kitchen: No (fridge and coffee/tea maker)

Trullo Il Palmento Suite is a 30 m² trullo at Tenuta Odegitria, in Martina Franca in the Itria Valley, recently restored as a romantic suite. It is also the bridal suite for weddings held at the estate.
It features an entrance hall, a double bedroom with the bed set in an alcove under the trullo dome, a relaxation corner and a bathroom with shower and private stone hot tub (available for a supplement, bookable on site). Air conditioning and underfloor heating; fridge and coffee/tea maker.
A cot and high chair are available free of charge on request. The swimming pool, tennis court and shared garden are available to guests; a buffet breakfast is served in the breakfast room on request.

Ideal for: Couples, honeymoons, anniversaries and newlyweds on their wedding night.

Q: Is breakfast included?
A: A typical buffet breakfast, served in the breakfast room, is available on request for an extra charge, so you can also book room only.

### Pino e Lecci Apartment

URL: https://tenutaodegitria.it/en/pinoelecci.html
Booking: https://tenutaodegitria.kross.travel/room-pino-e-lecci?lang=en

- Type: Apartment in the masseria (B&B)
- Guests: Up to 4
- Rooms: Lounge + 2 bedrooms
- Beds: 1 double bed + 2 single beds
- Bathroom: 1 large private bathroom, with shower
- Size: 50 m²
- Floor: First floor of the manor house, with balcony
- Kitchen: No (fridge)

The Pino e Lecci Apartment is on the first floor of the manor house of Tenuta Odegitria, a recently restored masseria with trulli in Martina Franca, in the Itria Valley. At 50 m² it is the largest accommodation on the estate.
It has an elegantly furnished lounge, a double bedroom, a bedroom with two single beds and a large bathroom for the exclusive use of the apartment. It also has a balcony, fridge, TV, air conditioning in summer and heating in winter. There is no kitchen: it is designed for a bed & breakfast stay, with buffet breakfast on request.
Outside there is a private area with a garden table and chairs; the estate’s swimming pool and tennis court are available to guests.

Ideal for: Two couples of friends or families with older children.

FAQ:

Q: How many guests can Pino e Lecci Apartment accommodate?
A: Up to 4 guests. Beds: 1 double bed + 2 single beds.

Q: What type of accommodation is Pino e Lecci Apartment?
A: A B&B apartment in the masseria of 50 m² at Tenuta Odegitria, a masseria with an 18th-century trulli hamlet in Martina Franca (TA), in the Itria Valley, Puglia. Ideal for: two couples of friends or families with older children.

Q: Does Pino e Lecci Apartment have a kitchen?
A: No, there is no kitchen (there is a fridge). A typical buffet breakfast is available on request for an extra charge.

Q: Is Pino e Lecci suitable for two couples?
A: Yes: the two bedrooms (one double, one twin) are separate and share the lounge and a large bathroom for the exclusive use of the apartment.

Q: Is breakfast included?
A: A typical buffet breakfast, served in the breakfast room, is available on request for an extra charge, so you can also book room only.

Q: Can guests use the swimming pool and tennis court?
A: Yes, guests have access to the estate’s outdoor swimming pool (6×14 m) and tennis court, shared with other guests. A shared hot tub is also available on request for an extra charge.

Q: Is there parking and Wi‑Fi?
A: Yes: free on-site parking with an electric vehicle charging station, and free Wi‑Fi. A car is recommended to explore the Itria Valley.

Q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
A: Check-in is from 2:00 pm, check-out by 10:00 am.

Q: Are pets allowed?
A: Yes, pets are welcome: please let us know when you book.

Q: Can we stay with a baby?
A: Yes, a cot and high chair are available on request.

Q: How do I book Pino e Lecci Apartment and what are the conditions?
A: Online from this page, with real-time availability and prices, or by contacting us on +39 338 565 5351 (also WhatsApp) or at info@tenutaodegitria.it. A 30% deposit is required to confirm the booking; the balance is paid on arrival by credit card, bank transfer or cash. With the refundable rate, cancellation is free up to 30 days before arrival.

Q: Where is Pino e Lecci Apartment located?
A: At Tenuta Odegitria, Strada Cupa-Battaglini 32/A, 74015 Martina Franca (TA), Puglia, Italy: 2 km from the centre of Martina Franca, 4 km from Locorotondo and 1 km from the SS 172 “dei Trulli” road, in the heart of the Itria Valley.

## General FAQ (English)

Q: Where is Tenuta Odegitria?
A: At Strada Cupa-Battaglini 32/A, 74015 Martina Franca (TA), Puglia, Italy: 2 km from the centre of Martina Franca, 4 km from Locorotondo and 1 km from the SS 172 “dei Trulli” road, in the heart of the Itria Valley. The baroque old town of Martina Franca, Locorotondo, Alberobello, Cisternino and the other Itria Valley villages are a short drive away.

Q: What kind of property is Tenuta Odegitria?
A: A masseria (traditional Apulian farmhouse estate) with an 18th-century trulli hamlet, recently restored and run directly by its owners, Anna Maria Calella and Giovanni Conserva, who live on the estate. It offers 6 accommodations as holiday rentals or bed & breakfast and hosts weddings and events.

Q: What accommodations are available and for how many guests?
A: Six accommodations for 2 to 4 guests each, 21 beds in total: four trulli (Trullo dell’Aia, Trullo La Corte, Trullo Il Pagliaio and Trullo Il Palmento Suite) and two on the first floor of the manor house (Agrifoglio Room and Pino e Lecci Apartment). Trullo dell’Aia, La Corte and Il Pagliaio have a kitchenette.

Q: What amenities are included?
A: A 6×14 m outdoor swimming pool, tennis court, free Wi‑Fi, free on-site parking, air conditioning, a garden with barbecue area and a private outdoor area for each accommodation. On request, for an extra charge: buffet breakfast and a shared hot tub. Cot and high chair on request. The car park has an electric vehicle charging station and pets are allowed.

Q: What are the check-in and check-out times? Are pets allowed?
A: Check-in from 2:00 pm, check-out by 10:00 am. Pets are welcome: please let us know when you book.

Q: Is breakfast included?
A: A typical buffet breakfast is available on request for an extra charge, so you can also book room only.

Q: How do I book and what are the conditions?
A: Directly on this website, with real-time availability and prices through the official booking system, or on +39 338 565 5351 (also WhatsApp) or at info@tenutaodegitria.it. A 30% deposit is required to confirm the booking; the balance is paid on arrival by credit card, bank transfer or cash. With the refundable rate, cancellation is free up to 30 days before arrival.

Q: Can we hold a wedding or event?
A: Yes. The estate is an officially recognised civil registry office (art. 3 DPR 396/2000), so legally valid civil ceremonies are held on site. The Italian garden, oak grove, threshing floor, pool area, trulli hamlet and a hall with panoramic windows host events of up to about 200 guests, with free choice of caterer.

Q: How far is Tenuta Odegitria from airports and nearby towns?
A: Approximate driving distances: Martina Franca old town 2 km, Locorotondo 4 km, Cisternino about 12 km, Alberobello about 13 km, Ostuni about 30 km, Taranto about 35 km, Adriatic Sea (Monopoli) about 35 km, Brindisi Airport about 60 km, Bari Airport about 80 km.

Q: What is there to see nearby?
A: The Itria Valley: the baroque old town of Martina Franca (2 km), Locorotondo (4 km), the UNESCO-listed trulli of Alberobello, Cisternino and Ostuni, plus wineries, masserie and scenic roads among olive groves and vineyards. A car is recommended.

## Wedding FAQ (English)

Q: Can we have a civil wedding at the estate?
A: Yes. Tenuta Odegitria is an officially recognised civil registry office (art. 3 DPR 396/2000): civil ceremonies are held on site with full legal validity, with no need to go to the town hall.

Q: What about a religious ceremony?
A: Nearby are the Church of Sant’Antonio ai Cappuccini, home to the devotion to the Madonna dell’Odegitria, and the historic baroque churches of Martina Franca.

Q: Which spaces are available?
A: The Italian garden, oak grove, threshing floor, pool area, the 18th-century trulli hamlet and an indoor hall with panoramic windows, which also serves as a rain plan.

Q: How many guests can the estate host?
A: The estate’s spaces host events of up to about 200 guests. For different numbers, contact us and we will find the best solution together.

Q: Do we have to use a specific caterer?
A: No, you are free to choose: bring your own caterer or pick one that already knows the venue, such as Sovrano Eventi (Alberobello), Rotondo Catering (Palagiano) or Il Fagiano (Fasano).

Q: Is the venue exclusive?
A: Yes: on your wedding day there are no other weddings, events or outside guests at the estate.

Q: Where can the couple and guests stay?
A: The couple in Trullo Il Palmento Suite with its private hot tub; family and friends in the trulli and masseria rooms (up to 21 beds in total), with a buffet breakfast the morning after.

Q: How do we request a quote or a visit?
A: Fill in the form on this page, email info@tenutaodegitria.it or call Anna Maria (+39 338 651 0960) or Giovanni (+39 339 674 5290).

Su richiesta sono disponibili gratuitamente culla e seggiolone. Piscina, campo da tennis e area giardino comune sono a disposizione degli ospiti; la colazione a buffet è servita nella sala colazioni su richiesta.

A: La vasca idromassaggio privata in pietra non è inclusa nella tariffa del soggiorno: si prenota direttamente in loco per i giorni desiderati, con un supplemento giornaliero.

Q: La colazione è inclusa?
A: La colazione tipica a buffet, servita nella sala colazioni, è disponibile su richiesta con un costo a parte; si può quindi prenotare anche solo il pernottamento.

Q: Si possono usare la piscina e il campo da tennis?
A: Sì, gli ospiti hanno accesso alla piscina all’aperto (6×14 m) e al campo da tennis della tenuta, condivisi con gli altri ospiti. Su richiesta, con costo a parte, è disponibile anche una vasca idromassaggio comune.

Q: C’è il parcheggio? E il Wi‑Fi?
A: Sì: parcheggio interno gratuito con colonnina di ricarica per auto elettriche e Wi‑Fi gratuito. Per visitare la Valle d’Itria è consigliata l’auto.

Q: Quali sono gli orari di check-in e check-out?
A: Il check-in è dalle 14:00, il check-out entro le 10:00.

Q: Gli animali sono ammessi?
A: Sì, gli animali domestici sono ammessi: segnalacelo al momento della prenotazione.

Q: Si può soggiornare con un neonato?
A: Sì, su richiesta mettiamo a disposizione culla e seggiolone.

Q: Come si prenota Suite Trullo Il Palmento e quali sono le condizioni?
A: Online da questa pagina, con disponibilità e prezzi in tempo reale, oppure contattandoci al +39 338 565 5351 (anche WhatsApp) o a info@tenutaodegitria.it. Per confermare la prenotazione è richiesto un acconto del 30%; il saldo si paga all’arrivo con carta di credito, bonifico bancario o contanti. Con la tariffa rimborsabile la cancellazione è gratuita fino a 30 giorni prima dell’arrivo.

Q: Dove si trova Suite Trullo Il Palmento?
A: A Tenuta Odegitria, Strada Cupa-Battaglini 32/A, 74015 Martina Franca (TA), in Puglia: a 2 km dal centro di Martina Franca, 4 km da Locorotondo e 1 km dalla SS 172 dei Trulli, nel cuore della Valle d’Itria.

### Appartamento Pino e Lecci

URL: https://tenutaodegitria.it/pinoelecci.html
Booking: https://tenutaodegitria.kross.travel/room-pino-e-lecci?lang=it

- Tipologia: Appartamento in masseria (B&B)
- Ospiti: Fino a 4
- Ambienti: Salone + 2 camere da letto
- Posti letto: 1 letto matrimoniale + 2 letti singoli
- Bagno: 1 ampio bagno privato, con doccia
- Superficie: 50 m²
- Piano: Primo piano della casa padronale, con balcone
- Cucina: No (frigorifero)

L’Appartamento Pino e Lecci si trova al primo piano della casa padronale di Tenuta Odegitria, masseria con trulli recentemente ristrutturata a Martina Franca, in Valle d’Itria. Con i suoi 50 m² è la sistemazione più ampia della tenuta.
È composto da un salone finemente arredato, una camera matrimoniale, una camera con due letti singoli e un ampio bagno a uso esclusivo dell’appartamento. Dispone di balcone, frigorifero, TV, aria condizionata in estate e riscaldamento in inverno. Non ha cucina: è pensato per la formula bed & breakfast, con colazione a buffet su richiesta.
All’esterno, uno spazio privato con tavolino e sedie da giardino; piscina e campo da tennis della tenuta sono a disposizione degli ospiti.

Ideale per: Due coppie di amici o famiglie con figli grandi.

## Domande frequenti (italiano)

D: Dove si trova Tenuta Odegitria?
R: In Strada Cupa-Battaglini 32/A, 74015 Martina Franca (TA), in Puglia: a 2 km dal centro di Martina Franca, 4 km da Locorotondo e 1 km dalla SS 172 dei Trulli, nel cuore della Valle d’Itria. Dalla tenuta si raggiungono in pochi minuti d’auto il centro storico barocco di Martina Franca, Locorotondo, Alberobello, Cisternino e gli altri borghi della Valle d’Itria.

D: Che tipo di struttura è Tenuta Odegitria?
R: È una masseria con un borgo di trulli del Settecento, recentemente ristrutturata e gestita direttamente dai proprietari, Anna Maria Calella e Giovanni Conserva, che vivono nella tenuta. Offre 6 sistemazioni in formula casa vacanza o bed & breakfast e ospita matrimoni ed eventi.

D: Quali sistemazioni ci sono e per quante persone?
R: Sei sistemazioni da 2 a 4 ospiti, per un totale di 21 posti letto: quattro trulli (Trullo dell’Aia, Trullo La Corte, Trullo Il Pagliaio e la Suite Trullo Il Palmento) e due sistemazioni al primo piano della casa padronale (Camera Agrifoglio e Appartamento Pino e Lecci). I trulli Aia, La Corte e Il Pagliaio hanno l’angolo cottura.

D: Quali servizi sono inclusi?
R: Piscina all’aperto di 6×14 m, campo da tennis, Wi‑Fi gratuito, parcheggio interno gratuito, aria condizionata, giardino con area barbecue e uno spazio esterno privato per ogni alloggio. Su richiesta, con costo a parte: colazione a buffet e vasca idromassaggio comune. Culla e seggiolone su richiesta. Nel parcheggio c’è una colonnina di ricarica per auto elettriche e gli animali sono ammessi.

D: Quali sono gli orari di check-in e check-out? Gli animali sono ammessi?
R: Check-in dalle 14:00, check-out entro le 10:00. Gli animali domestici sono ammessi: segnalacelo al momento della prenotazione.

D: La colazione è inclusa?
R: La colazione tipica a buffet è disponibile su richiesta con un costo a parte: si può prenotare anche solo il pernottamento.

D: Come si prenota e quali sono le condizioni?
R: Direttamente su questo sito, con disponibilità e prezzi in tempo reale tramite il sistema di prenotazione ufficiale, oppure al +39 338 565 5351 (anche WhatsApp) o a info@tenutaodegitria.it. Per confermare la prenotazione è richiesto un acconto del 30%; il saldo si paga all’arrivo con carta di credito, bonifico bancario o contanti. Con la tariffa rimborsabile la cancellazione è gratuita fino a 30 giorni prima dell’arrivo.

D: Si possono organizzare matrimoni ed eventi?
R: Sì. La tenuta è riconosciuta come ufficio separato dello stato civile (art. 3 DPR 396/2000), quindi il rito civile si celebra in loco con pieno valore legale. Giardino all’italiana, querceto, aia, piscina, borgo dei trulli e una sala con vetrate panoramiche ospitano eventi fino a circa 200 persone, con catering a libera scelta.

D: Quanto dista Tenuta Odegitria da aeroporti e località vicine?
R: Distanze stradali indicative: centro storico di Martina Franca 2 km, Locorotondo 4 km, Cisternino circa 12 km, Alberobello circa 13 km, Ostuni circa 30 km, Taranto circa 35 km, mare Adriatico (Monopoli) circa 35 km, aeroporto di Brindisi circa 60 km, aeroporto di Bari circa 80 km.

D: Cosa visitare nei dintorni?
R: La Valle d’Itria: il centro storico barocco di Martina Franca (2 km), Locorotondo (4 km), i trulli di Alberobello patrimonio UNESCO, Cisternino e Ostuni, oltre a cantine, masserie e strade panoramiche tra ulivi e vigneti. L’auto è consigliata.

## Matrimoni – domande frequenti (italiano)

D: Si può celebrare il matrimonio civile in tenuta?
R: Sì. Tenuta Odegitria è riconosciuta come ufficio separato dello stato civile (art. 3 DPR 396/2000): il rito civile si celebra in loco con pieno valore legale, senza spostamenti in municipio.

D: E per il matrimonio religioso?
R: Nelle vicinanze si trovano la Chiesa di Sant’Antonio ai Cappuccini, sede del culto della Madonna dell’Odegitria, e le storiche chiese barocche di Martina Franca.

D: Quali spazi sono disponibili?
R: Giardino all’italiana, querceto, aia, piscina, il borgo dei trulli del Settecento e una sala interna con vetrate panoramiche, che funge anche da piano B in caso di pioggia.

D: Quanti invitati può accogliere la tenuta?
R: Gli spazi della tenuta accolgono eventi fino a circa 200 persone. Per numeri diversi contattateci: valuteremo insieme la soluzione migliore.

D: Il catering è obbligatorio?
R: No, la scelta è libera: potete portare il vostro catering oppure scegliere tra quelli che già conoscono la struttura, come Sovrano Eventi (Alberobello), Rotondo Catering (Palagiano) e Il Fagiano (Fasano).

D: La location è in esclusiva?
R: Sì: il giorno delle nozze non ci sono altri matrimoni, eventi o ospiti esterni in struttura.

D: Dove possono dormire sposi e ospiti?
R: Gli sposi nella Suite Trullo Il Palmento con vasca idromassaggio privata; familiari e amici nei trulli e nelle camere della masseria (fino a 21 posti letto in tutto), con colazione a buffet la mattina dopo.

D: Come si richiede un preventivo o un sopralluogo?
R: Compilando il modulo in questa pagina, scrivendo a info@tenutaodegitria.it o chiamando Anna Maria (+39 338 651 0960) o Giovanni (+39 339 674 5290).
